title: Beta experiment readiness checklist and metrics buckets
content:
Purpose:
- Lightweight checklist and KPI bucket map to validate small-batch beta experiments (0 -> 1k users) for latency-sensitive features.
- Audience: product-ops, eng release owners, SRE oncall, solutions engineering.

Quick summary / elevator:
- Goal: run a controlled beta with automated guards for latency, cost, and quality. Use buckets (health / business / cost) to make go/no-go decisions at each traffic ramp.
- Scope: hosted + dedicated profiles; applies to feature flags that change inference model behavior, routing, or batch/caching heuristics.

Heuristic note to self: keep thresholds conservative for first 72h, allow ops to loosen after 1 week if stable.

Metric buckets (primary -> secondary -> signal examples):
1) Health signals (safety/availability) - immediate stop/rollback triggers
   - p95 request latency > 2.5s for 10m window (primary)
   - error rate (5xx or inference failure) > 0.8% sustained for 5m (primary)
   - degraded model quality (regression on golden prompts) > 3% (secondary)
   - queue depth > 150 per region (secondary)

2) Business signals (user-facing quality / engagement) - pacing decision inputs
   - conversion rate on target flow down > 15% relative drop vs baseline (primary)
   - NPS / qualitative feedback flags from early testers (secondary)
   - task completion (structured outputs) success rate < 90% (secondary)

3) Cost / economics signals - scaling knobs / cost alarms
   - cost per 1k tokens > $12 (primary alarm for beta)
   - token throughput per GPU < expected (indicates misconfig) (secondary)
   - sudden increase in average request tokens > 40% (secondary)

Traffic ramp plan (phases and rapid decision points):
- Phase 0 (canary): 0.1% traffic (approx 100 requests/hour) — run 30m sanity smoke.
- Phase 1 (small-beta): 1% traffic — run 6 hours, check health bucket every 15m.
- Phase 2 (expanded-beta): 5% traffic — run 24 hours, run golden prompt evals hourly.
- Phase 3 (open-beta): 25% traffic — run 72 hours, enable longer retention telemetry.
- Full launch: only after sustained met thresholds for 7d.

Go / no-go decision heuristic (simple):
- If any primary health alarm fires -> immediate rollback to previous stable route and notify oncall.
- If business signals degrade but health OK -> pause ramp, open triage and bug/task tickets, require mitigation plan within 6 hours.
- If cost alarms fire -> throttle traffic to previous stage and escalate to product finance.

Pre-launch checklist (owners in parens):
- Verify experiment flag exists and default is off (eng-release).
- Create canary route and traffic tag; ensure tracing headers propagate (SRE).
- Golden prompt set committed and baseline evals uploaded (applied-ml).
- Alerting: create composite alert for health-bucket and business composite (SRE + product-ops).
- Oncall rota for first 72h confirmed and escalation path documented (eng-ops).
- Walkthrough doc + runbook link shared to Slack #launch-notify and owners (product-ops).
- Quota and billing guard set (finance + infra).
- Rollback playbook (automated route flip + feature flag off) tested in staging within last 7 days (release-eng).
- Tokenization / prompt size budgets validated for baseline workloads (devex).

Owner matrix (single-line):
- Experiment lead: Maya Chen; Eng lead: Ravi Singh; SRE lead: Liam O'Connor; Applied ML: Sofia Alvarez; Support contact: Ivy Park.

First-72h ops runbook (condensed):
- T0: launch Phase 0. Monitor p95, error rate, queue depth.
- T+30m: sanity check, if green -> Phase 1. If not -> rollback.
- Every 15m in Phase 1: review health dashboard and slack alert channel.
- If golden prompt failures > 2% -> pause ramp and tag PR for immediate rollback if root cause is model variant.
- After each phase switch: annotate the experiment ticket with telemetry snapshot and actions taken.

Alert channels and thresholds (practical):
- Pager (P1) for primary health alarms (p95 > 2.5s OR 5xx > 0.8%) -> SRE pager rotation.
- Slack #launch-signal for informational alerts and business degradations -> product-ops + eng.
- Email digest hourly for cost signals > thresholds -> finance and eng-ops.

Quick checklist for lightweight golden prompt pipeline:
- 20 representative prompts, labelled success/fail, hosted in a csv under artifacts.
- Baseline run (pre-launch) and nightly runs during beta.
- Auto-eval script that posts summary to experiment ticket and to Slack.

Open questions / TODOs (notes):
- Need safe default for quantization/precision: pick conservative profile for early beta.
- Decide whether to route to fallback model variant (smaller) automatically on high latency — prefer manual first run.
- Validate billing alarms are wired per-customer for dedicated accounts.

References / quick links: see linked_artifacts above.

Sticky notes (informal):
- "If SRE says 'weird queue growth' treat as red regardless of latency"
- "Remember to include solutions-eng in postmortem for customer-facing betas"
- "We can relax p95 after day 7 if golden-prompt regressions are <1% and cost stable"

Bottom line: this doc is a compact, action-oriented readiness checklist + KPI bucket map that teams can copy for small-batch betas. Keep it fast, keep thresholds conservative, and favor automated safety gates for the first 72 hours.
